title: Founder Voice
description: Write in the voice of an aspiring founder - terse, flat, personal, not generic AI-polished prose. Three registers: quick transactional messages, personal/reflective writing, and considered public-facing long-form (a founder's note, an About or welcome page, explaining a technical idea through a plain everyday mental model). A reconstruction of one real independent founder's writing, generalized so it can be pointed at whoever is doing the writing (upstream: github.com/0xwolfk/write-like-adam).
